person.headline: Carbon fibre · Composites · Detailing
person.intro: Five years in carbon fibre, composites, detailing and PPF. I lay up, repair, refinish and protect the parts people care about most, and I build tools that make car parts easier to find.
person.short: From the first ply to the final polish.

materials.name: 280 g twill
materials.text: The classic carbon look. A 2×2 twill weave used as the top ply that everyone sees.

materials.name: UD carbon
materials.text: Every fibre runs one way. Maximum stiffness exactly along the load path.

materials.name: Aramid
materials.text: Gold aramid fibre. Very tough and impact-resistant, and notoriously hard to cut and sand.

materials.name: Dyneema
materials.text: Ultra-light polyethylene fibre with high cut and impact resistance.

materials.name: 10-ply carbon
materials.text: Ten plies laminated into one thick, rigid panel.

materials.name: Structural lay-up
materials.text: A lay-up built for parts that carry real load.

materials.name: Carbon + Divinycell
materials.text: Carbon skins over a 3 mm foam core. A sandwich that is stiff, light and quiet.

materials.name: Honeycomb core
materials.text: Honeycomb core for the highest stiffness at the lowest weight.

steps.name: Surface ply
steps.text: Pre-preg carbon weave, cured at 120 °C. This is the face of the part.

steps.name: Core
steps.text: 3 mm Divinycell foam adds thickness and stiffness for almost no weight.

steps.name: Backing plies
steps.text: Two more layers of pre-preg carbon close the sandwich.

steps.name: Release film
steps.text: Unperforated, Teflon-treated film that peels cleanly off the cured part.

steps.name: Breather
steps.text: A fleece that lets trapped air travel out of the laminate.

steps.name: Vacuum bag
steps.text: Sealed with vacuum tape and pulled down, so every layer bonds tight.

services.name: Lay-up & lamination
services.text: Pre-preg and wet lay-up, foam and honeycomb cores, vacuum bagging.

services.name: Repair & fibre replacement
services.text: Cracked or delaminated carbon cut back, re-fibred and blended in.

services.name: Sanding & polishing
services.text: Step-by-step wet sanding to a mirror finish without cutting into the weave.

services.name: Clear coat & lacquer
services.text: UV-stable clear coats that bring out depth and stop yellowing.

services.name: Paint & patterns
services.text: Colour, tints and custom designs on carbon: stripes, fades, partial paint.

services.name: Detailing
services.text: Paint correction, deep cleaning and protection inside and out.

services.name: PPF
services.text: Paint protection film that keeps paint and carbon safe from chips and scratches.

finish.title: Finish is everything
finish.text: Glass-fibre twill under a deep clear coat. A good part is decided in the last millimetre: the sanding, the clear coat, the way the weave catches the light.

detailing.title: Scratches out. Mirror in.
detailing.text: Aluminium and metal trim polished step by step: swirls and fine scratches cut away, then finished to a mirror and protected.
